_doc: Read by sdp-report-log-loop-metrics.ps1 at startup. Fixes a real bug: the script used to hardcode the CURRENT literal skill name for each of the four productive roles (WORKER/REVIEWER/COORDINATOR/GATE_REVIEWER) directly in its matching logic, so re-running the report against a historical date from BEFORE a skill's rename silently stopped recognizing that skill's old-named tone events -- they fell out of Productive-time bucketing entirely (reclassified as Idle), with no error or warning. Schema: `roles` is an array of { role, aliases }. `role` is the fixed canonical role identifier the script's own logic keys on (WORKER, REVIEWER, COORDINATOR, GATE_REVIEWER -- do not rename these four role keys, the script looks them up by exact name). `aliases` is every literal skillName/skill string this role has ever been logged under in a loop-metrics-*.jsonl file, OLDEST FIRST, CURRENT NAME LAST -- the script treats the last array entry as the canonical current name for display/comparison purposes and builds an alias-to-canonical lookup from every entry, so a historical event logged under any prior name normalizes to today's name before any interval computation, bucketing, or comparison happens. MAINTENANCE RULE for a future rename: append the new name to the end of that role's aliases array. Never remove or reorder an existing entry -- historical .jsonl files on disk still contain the old literal name and must keep resolving correctly. No script code change is needed for a rename to be handled correctly by this report; only this file changes. `offHoursThresholdMinutesDefault` is the default for the script's own -OffHoursThresholdMinutes parameter (used only when the caller does not pass that parameter explicitly -- an explicit -OffHoursThresholdMinutes always wins over this value). `unloggedGapThresholdSeconds` is the separate, intentionally-lower threshold (seconds) used only for the Data-quality "unlogged gap" anomaly notes -- distinct from the Off-hours bucket threshold above, see the script's own inline comment at the point of use for why the two thresholds must stay independent.
